notes.title: Steam Summer Sale and stuff!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,
First of all Spaceport Hope is off more than 50% for the Summer Sale so you can grab a copy for you or your friends if you haven't done so yet!

I wanted to make this a small progress report as well about SHDX. Some people are wondering about when it will be done or how much of the work is finished. To give some insight, the progress is bottlenecked on the programming. Almost all the new graphic assets are finished but a lot more is needed on the coding end. The code of the original Spaceport Hope is a complete mess, a real nightmare. After more than 2 months of refactoring and erasing more than 15 thousand lines of code I still have way to go :)
What's important is that I continue working on it steadily but I see the release happening somewhere in the first half of 2019 so you'll need to be a bit patient.
We plan on letting people test the game and give feedback earlier than that though.

Bonus: There are some early thoughts and considerations of making Spaceport Hope DX open source and releasing all the source code after it is finished! Give us your thoughts ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: A Huge update is on it's way...
notes.notes:
After quite some time, we're excited to announce that we're on the works of huge improvements to all aspects of Spaceport Hope! We're fixing, improving, adding and redesign in order to improve vastly what the game has to offer. It goes a bit further from an actual update and we consider it a standalone project, which includes the visual improvement of everything, better enemies and bosses, more stuff to do and improved gameplay experience.
You can join the new thread about the update to share your thoughts and be up to date about the it's progress!
([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/394540/discussions/0/1699415798759316416/]Discussion thread[/url])

Here's a small pick from the updated visuals from the town area
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/m2g4dirrqntdis2/sh_post_1.png[/img]

notes.title: External Visions - progress update
notes.notes:
Hallo everyone!

This post is a progress update for our new under-development game, External Visions. Although the original plans were to release the game this June - July the release will be delayed a bit more (just a little). That's all for good though, because this extra time we have been working exclusively on gameplay improvement and adding new content! So while the game is feature complete, we'll keep making additions and improvements for a little more time.
We'll make sure keep you up-to-date of our progress with future posts :)

Here's a photo from a newly added puzzle room:
[img]https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/t9iri7u9q1h51k4/1501841381759.png[/img]

The update also improves the performance of the game a bit.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.8
notes.notes:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.8 is now available and includes the following additions:

-Added a difficulty setting in the options menu. There are three different difficulty levels: Easy, Normal and Expert.
-Adjusted the movement of some flying enemies that were annoying and hard to hit
-Minor addition in tutorial level: Added ammo pickups and a sign to indicate them
-Added 'Escape' as shortcut key to return from menus.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Minor Update
notes.notes: This is a small update that removes the gun heating from the game because it was judged unnecessary and had a negative impact on the gameplay.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.6
notes.notes:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.6 is now available and includes fixes for the following issues:
 
-fixed sound bug that caused some of the sounds to play in mono channel
-fixed a glitch that allowed you to skip a part of the game
-addressed a small bug with bosses in slums area

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Achievement Update
notes.notes: This update includes a fix for losing obtained achievements when reinstalling the game. Achievements now are synced correctly with the Steam client.

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Update. v1.4.5
notes.notes:
Spaceport Hope v1.4.5 is now available and includes fixes for some bugs:

-fixed important texture issue. Users affected by this issue would get missing, black, noisy or distorted textures in various places.
-fixed blur background in menus, while using the non-streched fullscreenmode.
-small improvement in loading speed

notes.title: Spaceport Hope Minor Update
notes.notes: Uppon the multiple requests of the game's players, this update makes the lockpick item permanent; hence you can use it multiple items. It was not clear that this is a one-time item and many users had trouble with this, so we changed this. Some minor tweaks and fixes are included also in the update.
